_comment: USD per 1M tokens, cache-aware, DATE-EFFECTIVE. Each model maps to a list of entries sorted ascending by `effective` (YYYY-MM-DD). A session is priced with the entry whose effective date is the latest <= the session's date; a session dated before the earliest entry uses the earliest entry (so all historic sessions get today's prices). When Anthropic changes a price, ADD a new dated entry going forward — never edit a past entry. Derivations: cache_read = 0.1x input, cache_write(5m) = 1.25x input, blended = input rate (subagent tokens are a lump we can't split in/out, so this is a conservative lower bound). Source: claude-api skill pricing table, 2026-07-21.
